thread:
sarah-sales: Hey team — vendor security wants a concise access-provisioning bundle for the POC customer. They asked for SSO/SAML attribute mappings, evidence of enforced MFA, SCIM provisioning examples, RBAC roles (least-privilege examples), and service-account lifecycle + rotation logs. Deadline EOD Friday. Can we gather what exists? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

marta-sec: I can grab Console > IAM > Roles screenshots and export the role catalog CSV. Do they want a full role->permission matrix or just representative roles (org-admin, billing-admin, developer)? Also confirming: service account keys are KMS-encrypted at rest, right?

leo-se: Quick SAML snippet we recommend — paste for their reviewer:

leo-se: ```
NameID: email
AttributeStatements:
  - name: groups
    value: http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/claims/Group
  - name: uid
    value: user_id
```

leo-se: I'll also add the metadata endpoint and ACS URL they can validate against their IdP.

evan-solutions: MFA stance: we enforce SSO logins only; MFA is conditional and required for org-admin and billing-admin. I'll create a 1-page summary with the policy screenshot and a short note linking to our Okta/Azure guides.

marta-sec: Service-account lifecycle (high level):
- create service account (scoped role)
- issue time-limited API key (default TTL 30 days)
- automated rotation job replaces keys and updates deployments (k8s/secret manager)
- rotation and key deletion events logged in audit trail

marta-sec: I'll export a redacted audit log slice and include the rotation Cron config (example) for evidence.

sarah-sales: The risk reviewer also asked whether SCIM provisioning can be scoped/restricted to particular groups. Can we confirm?

leo-se: Yes — we support SCIM 2.0. In Console > Integrations > SCIM mappings you can map specific IdP groups to Redwood roles and restrict provisioning to only mapped groups. Example: IdP group "devs" -> Redwood role "developer:read+write".

evan-solutions: I'll draft a short HOWTO: "Connect SCIM + map groups -> roles" with screenshots and a curl example for a SCIM PATCH call they usually test.

evan-solutions: curl example:

```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/v2/Groups/{id} \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{"operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-12345"}]}]}'
```

marta-sec: For least-privilege evidence we keep a Confluence roles catalog grouped by surface (Console, API, Billing, Model Deploy). I'll export a trimmed CSV for the bundle and highlight the dev-only scopes.

sarah-sales: The risk team sometimes requires a short attestation from Security noting artifacts are current. Who can sign a one-paragraph attestation?

marta-sec: I can draft and sign: "Security has reviewed and attests that the attached artifacts accurately represent Redwood Inference SSO/SCIM/MFA and service account controls as of 2025-03-10. For verification, contact security@redwood.example.com."

idp-bot: Reminder: nightly audit export completed at 02:15 UTC (audit-export/2025-03-09-0215.csv).

evan-solutions: Plan: I will assemble SAML/SCIM snippets, the HOWTO, and curl examples today. Marta will add screenshots and the redacted audit slice. Sarah — can you consolidate and upload to the shared evidence folder? I will also add the small separation-of-duties matrix for admin vs billing.

sarah-sales: Yes — I'll pull everything into a zip and upload to https://redwood.app/shared/sales/poc-1234/evidence. Please drop final files there by Friday 18:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

leo-se: One last ask from their reviewer: show that org-admin actions require a change approval workflow (PR + two approvers). I'll include a short matrix that lists which UI/API actions are gated to org-admin vs billing-admin.

marta-sec: Noted. I'll include the RBAC screenshots and the internal change-approval flow doc snippet (redacted).

sarah-sales: Awesome — thanks all. Target: final bundle delivered by Friday 18:00 UTC.
